column1: # Process-count budgets of the Node hook (issue #168): the most external processes one run of proofline-hook.mjs may start per event on the benchmark fixture
# of tests/bench/hook-procs.sh (the PATH shim counts them: no clock is read). max = the measured count (REPEAT=3 median) plus a margin of max(2, 25 percent).
# The shell hook starts 13 to 540 processes per event (measured on the same fixture). tests/hook/budgets.test.mjs fails above max.
